scope: Consequences of the fixed modern lesson only. No native word profile, transcription, image, source count, encoder or fit was accessed. The working units and whole-word binding would be assumptions in any future manuscript application.
paid_physical_obligations: Every ADD, MIX and FORBID instruction explicitly writes its operation control, a complete literal vessel-name word, and the END control rry. No implicit current-vessel or sentence state replaces these words.

Each message ends in rrp. Each IF EMPTY writes rrl, its own complete literal vessel-name word, and a matching rrk after one or more complete instructions. Ordinary physical line ends close none of these scopes.

A literal name has rrd plus at least one payload character plus qq. Thus its minimum length is six working units when the single source character has an ordinary one-unit spelling; a single escaped character gives eight. A material literal may then carry preparation suffixes. These are construction lengths, not measured manuscript quantities.

An ordinary material root is nonempty and contains no rr. Strip preparation suffixes rro and rre from the right, then require the remaining ordinary root to obey that rule. Splitting at the first rr would be wrong when a legal root ends in r. A literal-name head instead ends at its syntactically distinguished qq terminator, after which only complete suffix triples are permitted.

The seven instruction/block controls all have exactly three units and start rr; rrch is a separate three-unit continuation control. Ordinary roots, literal frames and suffix-bearing material words cannot equal those complete controls under the fixed grammar.

Overwide words use the two paid rrch markers at the two line edges. Marker pairs are removed before lexical interpretation. Fragment cuts may not create a fragment equal to rrch; the declared one-unit-fragment fallback makes that possible without changing a word or adding an unrecorded character. This can be costly and requires a physically usable line width.
small_form_obligations: Every working unit can in principle be a learned one-unit ordinary root, including r. Two-unit roots are allowed except rr. Hence the earlier four-root, six-terminal and three-interior alphabets are not imposed by this grammar. This is capacity only, not a learned dictionary of actual manuscript forms.

No logical whole word of length two can be a control, literal name or preparation-derived material form. A two-unit interior word under this carrier must therefore be an ordinary learned root, unless the explicit physical continuation contract is independently present at the relevant line edges.

Every derived ordinary material word ends in o or e because the last preparation suffix is rro or rre. Ordinary roots themselves may have any final unit and may have arbitrarily diverse interiors. Assigning an observed long form to an unanalyzed learned root would pay its lexical meaning separately; it would not explain a native family by these two preparation operations.

A shortest complete message is MIX plus vessel-name plus END plus END-MESSAGE: four logical written groups. ADD or FORBID needs at least five. An IF containing a MIX requires at least seven. These minima cannot be bypassed by silently equating a line with a complete instruction or omitting its visible controls.
repetition_and_content: Within one ADD list, A A A is legal for any one complete material form and means three successive one-spoon additions of that exact stock and preparation history. A B A is also legal and preserves that order. This does not require N/V alternation, unique adjacent words or a sentence boundary between copies.

Within a FORBID list, repeated identical entries add no constraint and canonical writing lists each once. The quantity meaning of ADD repetition cannot be transferred to FORBID or to an arbitrary unbound native triple.

A whole root B and the longer root BB may both belong to the learned vocabulary, but their relation is not supplied by the notation. In particular BB inside one word does not request two spoons; only two separate material-word occurrences in ADD do so.

Dropping or duplicating one material token in an executed ADD changes the requested amount by exactly one shared level spoon. Changing the order of DRIED and GROUND changes the declared stock provenance, and can change which active prefix prohibition matches.
memory_and_learning_costs: Each independent material root requires a learned meaning and an identified stock, plus knowledge of which preparation operations are meaningful for it. Pronounceability or a short root does not remove that vocabulary cost.

The two preparation operations, eight controls including continuation, 95-character name transcription and frame parsing are additional taught rules. Literal names preserve their labels, not unknown material properties.

The reader retains one IF-entry truth value and consults the explicitly written outer and local prohibition lists. The union is not an invisible permission or exception mechanism. Repeated complete vessel names and large spoon counts can be expensive to write.

The shared level spoon is an external measured-volume convention. No mass, concentration, fractional quantity, timing, temperature or general medical instruction is recovered unless it is within the declared narrow source domain.
decision_limit: This note supplies finite hand-reading obligations for Root's prospective selection. It does not claim a useful frequency distribution, q-to-o explanation, final-y behavior, historical attestation or native meaning. No challenge has been generated, and no carrier repair is proposed.
